worldcombat.skill.mudsport.summary: Spread a mudflat over the chosen ground and turn the surface to mud: bodies standing in it have their Electric moves dampened. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.use.1: Lay mud before an Electric volley
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.use.2: Turn the fighting line into sticky mud
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.description.0: Flings mud at ground within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.description.1: Spreads a mudflat of radius %1$s blocks, lasting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.description.2: Bodies standing in the mudflat - friend and foe alike - are caked in mud: their Electric moves are multiplied by %1$s, and the mud ends as soon as they leave the flat or it disappears.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.description.3: The flat turns up to %1$s ground blocks into mud; the original blocks return when the flat expires.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.description.4: Starts up in %1$s, settles in %2$s and cools down in %3$s, all driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.form.0: Thick mud: a smaller, deeper flat (radius x0.8) that lingers longer (x1.3) and damps harder (factor x0.85), at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.form.1: Thin mud: a wider, shallower flat (radius x1.3) with -2 ticks start-up and x0.9 cooldown, at the cost of x0.72 life and shallower damping.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; %2$s wind-up, %3$s recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.preference.th: On = thick mud: radius x0.8, life x1.3, Electric factor x0.85, at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.15 cooldown. Off = thin mud: radius x1.3, -2 ticks start-up, x0.9 cooldown, at the cost of x0.72 life and shallower damping.
worldcombat.skill.mudsport.preference.ai: The companion lays mud only while a threat is within this distance; lower lays it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
On: only lay mud when a threat has the Electric type, saving it for the moves it really damps. Off: also use it as a setup field against any threat.
Push the mud at the foe
On, the flat is pressed between you and the threat so the fighting line turns muddy. Off, it is pressed at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to lay the mud.
